Driving

Advanced techniques

Choose an objective, then make the techniques serve it.

Choose an objective, then make the techniques serve it.

What it does

Fast laps, DRIFT scores and FLOW scores reward different decisions. Use a lap to practise one of them deliberately.

How to do it

For time: settle early and BOOST out. For DRIFT: sustain a bankable slide. For FLOW: link different useful actions.

Why use it

A clear aim makes a change to your line or build easier to judge.

Timing

For a flying start, build OVERCHARGE before the line, catch on GAS, cross the line and BOOST into the next lap.

Advanced

Try LOCK → DRIFT → EXIT → CATCH → BOOST, or SHIFT → DRIFT → EXIT → SHIFT → BOOST. If a chain becomes untidy, simplify it and rebuild.

Practise it

Try Cliffside. Tutorials give you a guided starting point.
